Read spec workbook

Source: R/spec.R
read_spec.Rd

Parses a specifications.xlsx-style workbook via [metacore::spec_to_metacore()] and flattens the result into the package's spec data frame format. Requires the `metacore` and `readxl` packages.

Usage

read_spec(
  path,
  dataset = NULL,
  where_sep_sheet = "Datasets",
  verbose = "silent"
)

Arguments

path

Path to the specification workbook.

dataset

Optional dataset name to subset to.

where_sep_sheet

Whether the where clauses are on a separate sheet.

verbose

metacore verbosity, one of `"silent"`, `"verbose"`.

Value

A spec data frame as produced by [read_spec_df()].

Details

Read a P21-style specification workbook
